RawTools.TakeOver.Title: Driver
RawTools.TakeOver.Description: The driver Windows has on this function, and the way to put it on WinUSB for raw access — and back.
RawTools.TakeOver.Others: other interface(s) on this PC are taken over by Nexaflow.
RawTools.TakeOver.State.Bound: Taken over: it is on WinUSB. Restoring gives it back {0}.
RawTools.TakeOver.State.BindIntent: A take-over did not finish. Restoring puts it right.
RawTools.TakeOver.State.BindFailed: The take-over failed part-way. Restoring puts it right.
RawTools.TakeOver.State.RestoreIntent: A restore did not finish. Restoring again puts it right.
RawTools.TakeOver.State.RestoreFailed: The restore failed. Restoring again puts it right.
RawTools.TakeOver.Status.LedgerUnread: The binding ledger could not be read: {0}
RawTools.TakeOver.Busy: A driver change is already under way.
RawTools.TakeOver.Already: It is already taken over; restoring gives it back its driver.
RawTools.TakeOver.RefusedBecause: It is not to be taken over: {0}.
RawTools.TakeOver.Declined: Windows' permission prompt was declined, so nothing changed.
RawTools.TakeOver.Failed: It could not be done: {0}. The bridge's steps are in the device's debug details.
RawTools.TakeOver.Done.Bound: Taken over: it is on WinUSB now. Windows is restarting it, and its Raw access tile appears when it is back.
RawTools.TakeOver.Done.Restored: Restored: Windows is giving it back its own driver.
RawTools.TakeOver.Done.RestoredAll: Every interface Nexaflow took over on this PC has its own driver back.
RawTools.TakeOver.Confirm.Title: Take over this interface?
RawTools.Restore.Confirm.Title: Restore its driver?
RawTools.Restore.Confirm.Message: Give {0} back {1}? Raw access to it ends, and Windows will ask for administrator permission.
RawTools.Restore.NotTaken: Nexaflow holds no binding for it, so there is nothing to restore.
RawTools.RestoreAll.Confirm.Title: Restore every driver?
RawTools.RestoreAll.Confirm.Message: Give all {0} interface(s) Nexaflow took over on this PC back their own drivers? Windows will ask for administrator permission once.
RawTools.Impact.NoDriver: Nothing on this PC uses it now, so nothing stops working.
RawTools.Impact.Stops: Windows will no longer use it as {0} through {1} until it is restored.
RawTools.Impact.SameModel: Another of the same model plugged in later gets WinUSB too, until it is restored.
RawTools.Raw.Title: Raw access
RawTools.Raw.Description: Talks to this function through WinUSB directly: control transfers, endpoint reads and writes, and a log of every transfer.
RawTools.Raw.Warning: Whatever is sent here goes straight to the device. Requests and data its maker did not document can change its settings, erase it, or start a firmware update.
RawTools.Raw.VendorWarning: A class or vendor request does whatever the device's maker decided — unknown ones can put a device into firmware-update or erase modes.
RawTools.Raw.Held: Held open: no other program can open it until you let go.
RawTools.Raw.TextTip: Send text as UTF-8; \r \n \t \0 \\ and \xHH are understood
RawTools.Raw.NotHex: That is not hex: use pairs of 0–9 and A–F, such as 02 01 FF.
RawTools.Raw.Bad: {0} must be a number from 0 to {1} — decimal, or hex after 0x.
RawTools.Raw.Status.SaveFailed: The session could not be saved: {0}
RawTools.Raw.Control.Confirm.Title: Send a control request?
RawTools.Raw.Control.Confirm.Message: Send {0} with {1} to {2}? A device can do anything with a request it is sent — change a setting, erase itself, restart into a firmware update.
RawTools.Raw.Control.Empty: The device answered with no data.
RawTools.Raw.Write.Confirm.Title: Write to the device?
RawTools.Raw.Write.Confirm.Once: Send {0} byte(s) to endpoint 0x{1:X2} of {2}? A device can do anything with what it is sent.
RawTools.Raw.Write.Confirm.Repeated: Send {0} byte(s) to endpoint 0x{1:X2} of {2}, {3} times, {4} ms apart? A device can do anything with what it is sent.
